map.VARK学习风格测试通过12个场景问题，评估你的学习偏好：视觉(V)、听觉(A): The VARK learning style test uses 12 scenario questions to assess your learning preference: Visual (V), Auditory (A), Read/Write (R) and Kinesthetic (K), helping you find the way of learning that suits you best.
map.每题选一个最像你的选项，也可用键盘 1–4 / ← →: Pick the option closest to you for each question; you can also use keys 1-4 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.每题 4 个选项分别对应 视觉(V) / 听觉(A) / 读写(R) / 动觉(: The 4 options of each question correspond to one learning style: Visual (V) / Auditory (A) / Read/Write (R) / Kinesthetic (K). Choose the one closest to you
map.没有标准答案，凭第一直觉选最自然: There are no right answers; go with your first instinct and pick the most natural option
map.多数人是「混合型」——结果会给出四种风格的占比与你的主导风格: Most people are a "mixed type" — the result shows the share of all four styles plus your dominant style
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.VARK是Neil Fleming提出的学习风格分类模型: VARK is a learning style classification model proposed by Neil Fleming
map.多数人是混合型学习风格，单一型较少: Most people have a mixed learning style; purely single-type profiles are rare
map.了解学习风格有助于选择高效学习策略: Understanding your learning style helps you pick efficient study strategies
map.VARK不限制能力，只是偏好不同: VARK does not limit ability; it only describes different preferences
map.学习规划：备考或学新技能时，先弄清自己偏视觉（V）、听觉（A）、读写（R）还是动: Study planning: when preparing for an exam or learning a new skill, first work out whether you lean Visual (V), Auditory (A), Read/Write (R) or Kinesthetic (K), then shape your notes and exercises around the dominant style.
map.教学 / 培训适配：老师或培训师可据此调整授课方式，比如给动觉型多安排实操、给读: Teaching and training fit: teachers and trainers can adapt delivery accordingly, for example giving kinesthetic learners more hands-on practice and read/write learners more text material.
map.团队协作：在跨部门项目中，了解成员的学习接收偏好，能减少「说了他没记住」的沟通损: Teamwork: in cross-department projects, knowing how members prefer to take information in reduces the "I told them but they did not remember" communication loss.
map.四型分别代表什么: What each of the four types means
map.V 视觉（图表、演示）、A 听觉（听讲、讨论）、R 读写（文字、清单）、K 动觉: V Visual (diagrams, slides), A Auditory (listening, discussion), R Read/Write (text, checklists), K Kinesthetic (experience, practice). Most people are a "mixed type"; this test lists your dominant and secondary types by score from high to low.
map.VARK 四型分别是什么？: What are the four VARK types?
map.V=视觉、A=听觉、R=读写、K=动觉，描述你更容易「接收和记住」信息的方式，而: V = Visual, A = Auditory, R = Read/Write, K = Kinesthetic. They describe the way you find it easier to receive and remember information, not how smart you are.
map.出现两个并列主导型怎么办？: What if two styles tie as dominant?
map.很常见。结果会同时列出，比如「VA 型」代表你听和看结合时效率最高，可据此搭配两: That is very common. The result lists both, for example a "VA type" means you are most efficient when combining listening and seeing, so you can pair the two learning styles.
map.风格相对稳定，但刻意练习其他通道也有帮助；把它当作优化学习的参考，而非固定标签。: Styles are relatively stable, but deliberately practising other channels helps too. Treat this as a reference for optimizing study, not a fixed label.
map.VARK学习风格测试通过12个场景问题评估学习偏好：视觉型(看图表/视频)、听觉: The VARK learning style test assesses your learning preference through 12 scenario questions: Visual (looking at charts and video), Auditory (listening to explanations and discussion), Read/Write (reading and writing) and Kinesthetic (hands-on practice), helping you find the way of learning that fits you best.
map.因材施教指导: Guidance for teaching to individual strengths
map.如何使用学习风格测试（VARK）: How to use the Learning Style Test (VARK)
map.逐题阅读情景，凭第一直觉选一个最像你的选项（视觉/听觉/读写/动觉）。: Read each scenario and go with your first instinct, picking the option closest to you (Visual / Auditory / Read/Write / Kinesthetic).
map.可用「上一题/下一题」或键盘 1–4、← → 切换；点题号可回去改。: Use "Previous / Next question" or the keys 1-4 and ← → to move around; click a question number to go back and change it.
map.答完全部 12 题会自动出结果，也可随时点「查看结果」。: After all 12 questions the result appears automatically, and you can also click "View result" at any time.
map.结果区给出四型占比、主导风格与对应学习策略，可复制保存。: The result section shows the share of each of the four styles, your dominant style and matching study strategies, and can be copied or saved.
map.每题 4 个选项分别对应 V（视觉）/ A（听觉）/ R（读写）/ K（动觉）: The 4 options of each question map to V (Visual) / A (Auditory) / R (Read/Write) / K (Kinesthetic)
map.选某项即给该风格计 1 分，共 12 题，各风格 0–12 分: Choosing an option gives that style 1 point; with 12 questions each style scores 0-12
map.得分最高者为主导风格；并列最高则为「多主导混合型」: The highest score is your dominant style; a tie for highest means a "multi-dominant mixed type"
map.占比 = 某风格得分 ÷ 总答题数 × 100%: Share = score of a style ÷ total answered questions × 100%
map.学习风格自我评估、学习方法优化、教育培训与因材施教参考。: Learning style self-assessment, study method optimization, and reference for education, training and teaching to individual strengths.
map.学习风格测试（VARK）是做什么的？: What does the Learning Style Test (VARK) do?
map.通过 12 个情景问题，评估你在视觉(V)、听觉(A)、读写(R)、动觉(K): Through 12 scenario questions it assesses your preference and share across the four learning styles Visual (V), Auditory (A), Read/Write (R) and Kinesthetic (K), helping you find the most efficient way to learn.
map.本工具在你的本地浏览器实时计算，不依赖服务器；结果反映你的作答偏好，仅作自我认知: This tool computes everything in real time inside your local browser with no server involved. The result reflects your answer preferences and is a self-awareness reference only, not any kind of ability judgement.
map.学生、教师、培训者与家长都适用——用于优化学习策略、备课与辅导方式。: Students, teachers, trainers and parents can all use it to optimize study strategies, lesson preparation and tutoring approaches.
map.不需要。所有计算均在你的设备本地完成，答题进度仅存本机，数据不会上传任何服务器。: Nothing is required to sign in. All computation happens locally on your device, progress is kept only on this machine, and no data is uploaded to any server.
